qualification: Comparable as a recorded single-factor historical control, not independently verified initial tensor arrays or causal proof. All 105 initial torch.save-serialization parameter hash records are compared, not regenerated; checkpoint bytes are CPU-hashed without model loading. Identical starts/predictions do not establish identical stochastic training trajectories. Single-seed MPS/backend variation remains a causal confound. Source equivalence is limited to the ten relevant source/package/lock files, not entire Git commits. No criterion outcome is scored here.

train_order.basis: same verified manifest shard order and within-shard byte order, identical loader and seeded Python shuffle source; reconstructed IDs only, not a recorded training trace

inference_jobs.historical_inference_before_after_eviden: Driver hashes checkpoint before loading and after each child process; receipt records equality. Review independently rehashes current files twice, not a retroactive observation of inference.
